notes: Branch material requests (ST_ITEM_REQ, types EFFECT 7 / TRNS_TYPE 12; unused, no types configured): numbering (DATE_SERIAL per store/date), store from type, offline-branch and same-store checks, quantities and BASIC_QTY, lock once converted (APP_RULES_SA); fill helpers تزويد عام / أصناف حد الطلب, outstanding-PO and project-estimate warnings, delete refused when converted, item count / project reference (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.CURR_BAL.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round(nvl(get_balance((select r.store_code from st_item_req r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), t.group_code, t.item_code), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.FROM_STORE_BAL.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round(nvl(get_balance((select r.from_store_code from st_item_req r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), t.group_code, t.item_code), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 12 AND T.STORE_CODE IS NOT NULL) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))
